site.name: Ninefold
site.tagline: Numerology that shows its math, and never leaves your browser.
privacy.line: Calculated in your browser. Nothing is sent or saved.
disclaimer: Numerology is a symbolic tradition. There is no scientific evidence that it predicts events. Use it for reflection or fun, not for decisions about health, money, legal matters or relationships.
form.title: Your numbers, worked out in front of you
form.intro: Enter the name on your birth certificate and your birth date. Every number comes with its arithmetic, and nothing you type leaves this page.
form.birthName.help: As written on your birth certificate, in Latin letters (A to Z).
form.usedName.help: Optional. If you go by a different name, it gets its own set of numbers.
form.advanced: Advanced: the conventions behind the numbers
form.advanced.help: Published sources disagree on several rules. These are the defaults, and each switch shows what changes.
form.error.name: Enter your birth name.
form.error.date: Choose a day, month and year.
form.redirect: Your details are never stored, so a reload clears them. Please enter them again.
form.under16: You are under 16, so this site keeps analytics switched off for you. It does not save anything either way.
reading.karmicNote: Some versions of the tradition explain a karmic debt as a lesson carried over from earlier. Whatever you think of that, read it as a recurring theme.
reading.exportPdf: Year report (print or save as PDF)
reading.exportNote: Exports are made in your browser and carry numbers only. They do not include your name or birth date.
reading.rhythmNote: The personal day counts up by one and wraps from 9 to 1, so each number comes back about every nine days. A 1 starts a new loop.
timeline.hint: Drag the marker, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to see any age.
common.error: The readings could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload.
caution.intro: A tendency to watch, never a forecast. Each one comes from the shadow side of the number, and each ends on something small you can do.
caution.safety.heading: True on every day, whatever your numbers say
between.title: Between us
between.intro: Add someone to see your numbers side by side. It works for any two people: a friend, a parent, a colleague, someone you love. It shows what each number tends to bring and where the two meet.
between.stance: This page does not judge a pair. What helps most in any relationship is how two people treat each other, so it gives you things to talk about.
between.consent: Their details stay in this tab, like yours. Ask them first if you can.
between.nickname.help: Optional. It is only shown on this screen, never in an image, a link or a request.
between.under16: Someone you added is under 16, so this site keeps analytics switched off. It does not save anything either way.
between.relateHeading: How each number tends to relate
between.cyclesIntro: Personal years, months and days all count up by one and wrap from 9 to 1. Two people's numbers sit a fixed number of steps apart. This is how many.
between.stripCaption: Both people's personal-year numbers for nine years
between.safety.heading: Worth remembering
between.exportNote: The picture is drawn in your browser and carries numbers only: no names, no birth dates, no nickname.
between.error.date: Choose a day, month and year.
between.nav.label: Between us sections
between.days.intro: Each of you has your own personal day. The gap between the two numbers is the same as on the Overview, so the two days sit that many steps apart on the nine-day rhythm.
between.days.question: A question for the day
between.month.intro: Your numbers are on the left of each date and theirs are on the right. Pick a date to open both days.
between.month.yearCaption: Personal month for each month of the year, both people
between.life.intro: Each person's pinnacles and challenges come from their own birth date. They are drawn on one calendar-year axis so you can see where each of you is in life. They are shown together, not compared.
between.life.chartLabel: Pinnacles and challenges for both people on one calendar-year axis. The table under each person lists every period.
